scope: zero/one/many result cardinality through derived ValueBundle

genericExtensionF2a.result: GREEN: one unchanged form-agnostic research kernel executed three portable Link-defined Rules returning zero, one and multiple values as the accepted derived BundleValue surface across two independent replay Memories. The kernel has zero per-form/cardinality branches; singleton BundleValue remains distinct from LinkValue. Unknown Use fails closed, competing semantic Rules are rejected as authority ambiguity, and post-freeze live Theory mutation cannot alter the frozen selected Rule set.
genericExtensionF2a.authorClarification: R/result is more general than a single Link and may return a bundle. F2a must preserve zero/one/many value cardinality rather than accidentally impose single-valued function semantics.
bundleBoundary: ValueBundle is a derived structural value surface, not a new foundational ontology entity
multiple values from one selected Rule != multiple competing semantic Rules
genericExtensionF2a.consequence: Per-form application semantics can be compressed to one generic Link-rule kernel for ordinary acyclic result templates without imposing single-valued function semantics. F2b source/name binding, cyclic/self-incidence result construction, and the E2 source authority of generic unification/instantiation remain open; F-KERNEL-SELF-EXTENSION stays RED overall.

aspectApplicationA11.hypothesis: Application is not an additional MTS primitive. Candidate reading: ordinary Link construction itself carries application, while the four self-incidence aspects are four intrinsic cases/modes of that same Link structure.
ontologyBoundary: no Apply primitive is added to the foundation
function, argument, relation, tuple/pair and currying terminology are explanatory projections only unless derived
sequence of applications is nested Link structure, not a foundational Sequence entity
ValueBundle remains a derived result projection, not a foundational result container
F2a applyFrozenExtension is an external research helper name with no ontological authority
executableStructuralEquations: R = R(R) because R = R ⟼ R and ordinary ensure(R,R) reuses R
O = O(R) because poles(O) = (O,R) and ordinary ensure(O,R) reuses O
C = R(C) because poles(C) = (R,C) and ordinary ensure(R,C) reuses C
L = O(C) because L = O ⟼ C
U = C(O) because U = C ⟼ O
aspectApplicationA11.continuationCandidate: For ordinary non-self-referential cases, left-nested Link construction F⟼a, (F⟼a)⟼b, ((F⟼a)⟼b)⟼c requires no arity tag. The previous result Link is structurally eligible to occupy the start/function pole of the next Link.
relationToF2a: F2a already proves one generic rule kernel can interpret an application-shaped Link to ZERO/ONE/MANY derived BundleValue results with zero per-form host branches
A11a does not yet derive F2a rule selection, unification, instantiation or BundleValue projection from the four aspects
therefore A11a is structural evidence for a unifying foundation hypothesis, not semantic closure
falsifiersStillOpen: derive or reconstruct result/continuation authority from Link aspects rather than an independently privileged Apply/rule interpreter
show all four aspects participate under one generic law rather than five hard-coded basis equations
show bundle-valued continuations under frozen authority without treating live adjacency as result authority
show recursive/self-incidence construction without START/END-specific host builders
reconstruct the same law across two Memories from portable MTS evidence
falsify the need for an independent application primitive
aspectApplicationA11.consequence: The existing rooted basis is structurally consistent with reading Link itself as application: R/O/C/L/U are canonical fixed/degenerate/ordinary cases of the same two-pole constructor, and arbitrary argument depth is ordinary left-nesting. This does not yet prove that MTS evaluation/result semantics are fully derivable from the aspect basis.
